- **mobile**: don't map camera touch pressure to jump
On Android/Pixel, pointer pressure varies during camera drag. Mapping
pressure > 0.5 to jump left the control stuck true when the finger
stopped or lifted (no further pointermove to clear it), causing infinite
on-the-spot jumping. Camera drag must not own jump input. [`23f7394`](/commit/23f73944778496a5d2d5d8cf57146a3dad0c213d)
